player_prompt.intro:
I kpaŋa Countdown yelege kɛlɛ!
Kɔrɔ: Kpaŋa yelege kɛlɛ lafi +, -, *, / nɛra kɛlɛ ka tao.
Kɛlɛ format: [i j op] ka i,j bɛ indices nɛ op bɛ kɛlɛ.
Yɛlɛma: [0 2 *] kpaŋa yelege kɛlɛ lafi 0 nɛ yelege kɛlɛ lafi 2.
Kɛlɛ pɔrɔtɛɛ bɛ kɛlɛ ka tao kɛlɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ.
